content.text:
**Root cause:** `relocation-fetch-merge` was stuck since **2026-09-29** on:

`Exec format error: '/app/target/fetch-scheduler'`

The panel image had baked in a **macOS Mach-O** binary from local `target/fetch-scheduler`. Description prefetch ran that binary and the exception aborted **every** merge pass. The Go worker kept scraping (`FETCH_READY` / cycles every ~6h), but nothing was written into `matching_jobs` (last fetch was **Sep 28**). Backlog was **~6300** pending `fetch_http_results`.

**Hotfixed on EC2**
- Replaced the Mach-O with the Linux ELF from the worker image
- Passed SQS/AWS env into merge (so country opportunity refresh can enqueue)
- Merge is draining again (`merged 500…`, pending ~4800 and falling)

**Local guards so this doesn’t recur** (not deployed yet)
- `.dockerignore` + rsync exclude `target/`
- `prefetch_descriptions` catches `OSError` so a bad binary skips describe instead of killing the pass
- deploy script passes SQS/AWS into the merge container

Say if you want a panel rebuild/deploy to bake these in permanently. Until then, don’t recreate `relocation-fetch-merge` from the old image without re-copying the Linux binary.
